title: WebGPU Parallax Occlusion Mapping in Rust with wgpu
description: Build parallax occlusion mapping in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu using a glTF plane, tangent-space lighting, layered height sampling, and KTX textures.
imageAlt: Oblique WebGPU view of rocky cobblestones with simulated depth from parallax occlusion mapping.
